note: City of Atkinson park of about 50 acres, 1 mile west of downtown, with a 14-acre fishing lake, a hiking trail, disc golf and picnic areas; some directories call it 'Atkinson Lake State Rec Area', but the city runs it. Level grassy pull-ins under shade trees with little site demarcation; a 40-ft fifth-wheel has fit. RV dump at the Atkinson Community Center, 206 Hwy 20 ($3 donation suggested). --Claude
summary: The city's page is behind a Cloudflare captcha today, so this rests on the direct read saved 2026-10-15 plus today's search-indexed text: $20 RV sites (stored), no reservations, open year-round, a shower house, no dump on site (Community Center, $3 donation), 24 RV sites, phone (402) 925-5313. Those groups are written. On imagery the stored creekside does not hold: the stream beside the campground is the lake's outlet below a weir, ~10-15 m wide, with the west park road and a playground/shelter area between it and the camping. The 14-acre lake is ~65 m from the nearest RVs, across a road and a tree clump. Down to not waterfront.
flags: WATERFRONT creekside -> not waterfront (unsure -> down). (1) The channel along the campground's west side is the lake's outflow below a weir. NAIP gives it ~10-15 m wide (creek class), and the park's west loop road plus a playground/shelter day-use strip run between it and every RV site. (2) The Elkhorn proper is south of the highway bridge. (3) The 14-acre lake's SE arm ends at the weir ~65-70 m NW of the northern RV row. 3DEP puts the lake (2093 ft) level with the campground (2092-2095 ft), so it is not below a dam. But the gravel park road and a clump of large trees stand between the north-row RVs and the water. A lakeview call for the two or three most north-westerly sites is possible but not confirmed; went down per AWH 2026-11-02.
